Sakyti ar daryti tą patį iš naujo.
To say or do the same thing again.
The pupil repeats new words.

Ji rodo, kaip gerai kalbėti ir rašyti.
It shows how to speak and write well.
At school we learn Lithuanian language grammar.

Sakyti kitos kalbos žodžius savo kalba.
To say the words of another language in your own language.
Mokytojas verčia žodžius į lietuvių kalbą.
The teacher translates the words into the Lithuanian language.

Tai sakome, kai ko nors nežinome.
This we say when we do not know something.
I have for you one question.

Sakyti žodžius kitam žmogui, nes nori žinoti.
To say words to another person, because you want to know.
The child asks the father about work.

Kai rašai ar sakai ne taip, kaip reikia.
When you write or say not as is needed.
The teacher found a mistake in my work.

Nebežinoti, kur padėjai daiktą ar ką turėjai padaryti.
To no longer know where you put a thing or what you had to do.
I forgot where I put the keys.

Ilgai nebegalvoti apie senus draugus ir jų vardus.
For a long time not to think about old friends and their names.
He forgot his old friends.

Vėl galvoti apie tai, kas buvo prieš daug metų.
To think again about what was many years ago.
I often remember childhood summers in the countryside.

Laikyti galvoje vardą, dieną ar telefono numerį.
To keep in mind a name, a day or a telephone number.
Do you recall my telephone number?

Žmogus, kuris dirba ten, kur perkame maistą ir drabužius.
A person who works where we buy food and clothes.
In the shop works a young shop assistant.

Kiek pinigų reikia mokėti už daiktą.
How much money one must pay for a thing.
The coat's price is very big.

Už daiktą reikia mokėti tiek ir tiek pinigų.
For a thing one must pay so much money.
This coat costs much money.

Parduotuvė, kurioje perkame tai, ką skaitome.
A shop in which we buy what we read.
My sister works in a bookshop.

Pinigai, kuriuos gauni, kai moki per daug.
The money which you get when you pay too much.
I got change from the shop assistant.

Laikyti daiktą taip, kad kitas jį matytų.
To hold a thing so that another would see it.
She showed us her photographs.

Parduotuvėje žiūrėti, ar drabužis tinka.
In the shop to look at whether a garment fits.
She tries on a new dress.

Popierius, su kuriuo blogą daiktą gali grąžinti.
A paper with which you can return a bad thing.
This clock has a year's guarantee.

Popierius, kuris rodo, kaip veikia naujas daiktas.
A paper which shows how a new thing works.
The father reads the new car's instructions.

Paltas, sijonas ar kojinės; tai rengiamės kasdien.
A coat, a skirt or socks; these we put on every day.
This garment for me is too big.

Maži šilti drabužiai; juos maunamės prieš batus.
Small warm garments; we pull them on before the shoes.
My socks are of wool.

Švarkas ir kelnės iš vienos medžiagos.
A suit jacket and trousers of one fabric.
He bought a new suit.

Baltas drabužis; jį vyrai rengiasi po švarku.
A white garment; men put it on under a suit jacket.
I bought a new shirt.

Šiltas drabužis iš vilnos; jį rengiamės žiemą.
A warm garment of wool; we put it on in winter.
In winter I put on a warm sweater.

Lengvas moters drabužis; jį rengiasi su sijonu.
A light woman's garment; she puts it on with a skirt.
She bought a white blouse.

Ilgas šiltas drabužis; jį rengiamės į lauką žiemą.
A long warm garment; we put it on to go outside in winter.
In winter without a coat it is cold.

Moterų drabužis ant kojų; ne kelnės.
A women's garment on the legs; not trousers.
She bought a red skirt.

Trumpas drabužis su užtrauktuku; jį rengiamės į lauką rudenį.
A short garment with a zipper; we put it on to go outside in autumn.
The child lost the jacket at school.

Ilgas moterų drabužis; jį rengiasi į šventę.
A long women's garment; she puts it on for a celebration.
Ji buvo su gražia mėlyna suknele.
She was in a beautiful blue dress.

Kostiumo dalis su sagomis; ją rengiamės į darbą.
A part of a suit with buttons; we put it on for work.
The director was in a black suit jacket.

Skaičius, kuris rodo, ar drabužis tinka.
A number which shows whether a garment fits.
What is your shoe size?

Lengvi vasaros batai; su jais kojoms nekaršta.
Light summer shoes; in them the feet are not hot.
By the sea we go in sandals.

Juos dedame ant kojų, kai einame į lauką.
We put them on the feet when we go outside.
In the shop I bought new shoes.

Minkšti batai namuose; su jais nešalta kojoms.
Soft shoes in the house; in them the feet are not cold.
At home I am always in slippers.

Ilgas plonas daiktas; juo siuvame ir iš jo mezgame.
A long thin thing; with it we sew and from it we knit.
Grandmother knits from thick threads.

Plonas aštrus daiktas; su juo siuvame.
A thin sharp thing; with it we sew.
Mama siuva su adata ir siūlu.
Mother sews with a needle and thread.

Iš jos siuvame drabužius; ji šilta ar lengva.
From it we sew garments; it is warm or light.
Mother bought beautiful fabric.

Šilta medžiaga nuo avies; iš jos megztiniai.
Warm fabric from a sheep; from it come sweaters.
This sweater is of wool.

Balta medžiaga iš augalo; iš jos marškiniai.
White fabric from a plant; from it come shirts.
My shirts are of cotton.

Labai lengva ir graži medžiaga suknelėms.
A very light and beautiful fabric for dresses.
Mother's dress is of silk.

Mažas daiktas; jis uždaro striukę ir kelnes.
A small thing; it closes the jacket and the trousers.
My jacket's zipper does not work.

Mažas daiktas, kur laikome eurus ir korteles.
A small thing where we keep euros and cards.
I found a wallet on the table.

Jį imame į lauką, kai lyja.
We take it outside when it rains.
Without an umbrella in the rain you will be wet.

Daiktas ant sienos ar ant rankos; jis rodo valandas ir minutes.
A thing on the wall or on the arm; it shows the hours and the minutes.
The father gave me a new watch.

Ilgas odos daiktas; jį dedame ant kelnių.
A long leather thing; we put it on the trousers.
He bought a black belt.

Gražus mažas daiktas ant kaklo ar rankos.
A beautiful small thing on the neck or the hand.
She wears many pieces of jewellery.

Maži papuošalai; moterys juos nešioja ausyse.
Small pieces of jewellery; women wear them in the ears.
The girl got new earrings.

Plonas ilgas papuošalas; jį nešioja ant kaklo.
A thin long piece of jewellery; it is worn on the neck.
Mother got a beautiful necklace.
